categories.name: Analytical Equipments
categories.description: Advanced analytical instruments for precise chemical and material analysis.

products.name: Natural Gas Analyzer
products.description: Fully configured GC system for complete analysis of natural gas composition per ASTM and ISO standards.
products.fullDescription: The Natural Gas Analyzer is a fully configured gas chromatography system designed for complete analysis of natural gas composition. It meets rigorous international standards including ASTM D1945 and ISO 6974, delivering accurate quantification of methane, ethane, propane, butanes, pentanes, CO2, N2, and H2S. The system features advanced valve switching technology for seamless multi-component analysis with minimal operator intervention.

products.name: Oxygenates Analyzer
products.description: Specialized GC system for determination of oxygenate content in gasoline and fuel samples.
products.fullDescription: The Oxygenates Analyzer is a specialized gas chromatography system engineered for precise determination of oxygenate content in gasoline and fuel samples. Compliant with ASTM D4815 and D5599 standards, it accurately measures methanol, ethanol, MTBE, ETBE, TAME, and other oxygenated compounds.

products.name: Refinery Gas Analyzer (Mach-RGA)
products.description: Multi-component refinery gas analyzer for complete analysis of C1–C6+ hydrocarbons and permanent gases.
products.fullDescription: The Mach-RGA Refinery Gas Analyzer is a state-of-the-art multi-component analysis system designed for comprehensive characterization of refinery gas streams. It delivers complete analysis of C1 through C6+ hydrocarbons alongside permanent gases.

products.name: SimDis Analyzer
products.description: Simulated distillation analyzer for boiling point distribution of crude oils and petroleum fractions.
products.fullDescription: The SimDis Analyzer is a high-temperature gas chromatography system specifically designed for simulated distillation analysis. It determines the boiling point distribution of crude oils and heavy petroleum fractions per ASTM D2887, D7169, and D7213 standards.

products.name: Crude Oil Analyzer
products.description: Comprehensive crude oil analysis system for detailed hydrocarbon characterization and quality assessment.
products.fullDescription: The Crude Oil Analyzer is a comprehensive multi-detector gas chromatography system built for detailed hydrocarbon characterization and quality assessment of crude oil samples.

products.name: Detailed Hydrocarbon Analyzer (DHA)
products.description: High-resolution GC system for detailed hydrocarbon analysis of petroleum products.
products.fullDescription: The Detailed Hydrocarbon Analyzer (DHA) is a high-resolution gas chromatography system engineered for individual component identification and quantification in complex petroleum product matrices.

products.name: LPG Analyzer (ASTM D2163)
products.description: Dedicated analyzer for compositional analysis of liquefied petroleum gas per ASTM D2163.
products.fullDescription: The LPG Analyzer is a dedicated gas chromatography system designed for precise compositional analysis of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in full compliance with ASTM D2163.

products.name: SARA Analyzer
products.description: HPLC-based analyzer for determination of Saturates, Aromatics, Resins, and Asphaltenes in bitumen and heavy oils.
products.fullDescription: The SARA Analyzer is an HPLC-based analytical system for the determination of Saturates, Aromatics, Resins, and Asphaltenes (SARA) fractions in bitumen, crude oil, and heavy petroleum feedstocks.

products.name: Sulfur Trace Analyzer
products.description: Ultra-sensitive sulfur detection system for trace-level sulfur analysis in fuels and petrochemicals.
products.fullDescription: The Sulfur Trace Analyzer is an ultra-sensitive gas chromatography system equipped with SCD, AED, and FPD detection technologies for trace-level sulfur compound analysis.

products.name: Transformer Oil Gas Analyzer
products.description: Dissolved gas analysis system for transformer oil monitoring and diagnostics.
products.fullDescription: The Transformer Oil Gas Analyzer (TOGA) is a multi-detector gas chromatography system specifically designed for dissolved gas analysis (DGA) in transformer insulating oils.

specs.value: H2, CH4, C2H2, C2H4, C2H6, CO, CO2

products.name: UOP 603-13 Gas Analyzer
products.description: Specialized gas analyzer for refinery fuel gas and off-gas analysis per UOP method.
products.fullDescription: The UOP 603-13 Gas Analyzer is a specialized multi-valve gas chromatography system engineered for refinery fuel gas and off-gas analysis per the UOP 603-13 method.

products.name: AED III High Resolution
products.fullName: AED III High Resolution — Atomic Emission Detector
products.description: The only commercially available Atomic Emission Detector for gas chromatography, detecting trace elements at picogram level sensitivity.
products.fullDescription: The AED III High Resolution is the only commercially available Atomic Emission Detector (AED) for gas chromatography, offering unparalleled elemental selectivity and picogram-level sensitivity.

products.name: AED III Wide Range
products.fullName: AED III Wide Range — Atomic Emission Detector
products.description: Wide-range Atomic Emission Detector with extended elemental coverage for comprehensive multi-element analysis.
products.fullDescription: The AED III Wide Range is an advanced Atomic Emission Detector offering extended elemental coverage for comprehensive multi-element analysis in a single chromatographic run.

products.name: Vaporizer
products.description: Precision vaporizer for accurate vapor-phase conversion of liquefied gases and volatile samples.
products.fullDescription: The E-Vaporizer is a precision-engineered sample vaporization system for accurate vapor-phase conversion of liquefied gases and volatile samples prior to GC injection.

products.name: Automatic Gas Sampler (GBS)
products.description: Fully automated gas sampling solution for precise collection from Tedlar bags, balloons, or cylinders.
products.fullDescription: The Automatic Gas Sampler (GBS) is a fully automated gas sampling solution designed for precise, reproducible collection from Tedlar bags, balloons, or gas cylinders.

products.name: Gas Injection Control Unit (GICU)
products.description: Automated precision gas injection control for reproducible analytical results.
products.fullDescription: The Gas Injection Control Unit (GICU) is an automated precision gas injection system engineered to deliver highly reproducible analytical results in gas chromatography.

products.name: UNIS 2100 PTV
products.description: Programmable temperature vaporization inlet for solvent venting, VOCs, and general GC applications.
products.fullDescription: The UNIS 2100 PTV is a versatile programmable temperature vaporization inlet designed for solvent venting, volatile organic compound (VOC) analysis, and general GC applications.

products.name: UNIS 3100 HT PTV
products.description: High-temperature PTV inlet for heavy hydrocarbons, SimDis, and DHA applications.
products.fullDescription: The UNIS 3100 HT PTV is a high-temperature programmable temperature vaporization inlet engineered for the analysis of heavy hydrocarbons, simulated distillation (SimDis), and detailed hydrocarbon analysis (DHA).

products.name: UNIS 500 S/SL
products.description: Standard split/splitless inlet for routine GC, petrochemicals, and QC laboratory applications.
products.fullDescription: The UNIS 500 S/SL is a standard split/splitless inlet designed for routine gas chromatography, petrochemical analysis, and QC laboratory applications.

products.name: UNIS HT SimDis
products.description: Dedicated high-temperature inlet for simulated distillation analysis.
products.fullDescription: The UNIS HT SimDis is a dedicated high-temperature inlet specifically engineered for simulated distillation analysis.

products.name: CryoTrap
products.description: Cryogenic trapping system for pre-concentration of volatile compounds in GC analysis.
products.fullDescription: The CryoTrap is a cryogenic trapping system designed for pre-concentration of volatile organic compounds in gas chromatography analysis.

products.name: Olfactometer
products.description: GC-olfactometry system for sensory analysis and aroma compound identification.
products.fullDescription: The Olfactometer is a GC-olfactometry (GC-O) system that enables human sensory evaluation coupled with gas chromatographic separation for aroma compound identification.

products.name: Preparative Fraction Collector (EzPrep)
products.description: Automated preparative fraction collector for isolation and purification of GC-separated compounds.
products.fullDescription: The EzPrep is an automated preparative fraction collector designed for isolation and purification of individual compounds separated by gas chromatography.

products.name: MPS Robotic Smart Series
products.description: Multi-purpose robotic sample preparation and injection system for automated GC and LC workflows.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel MPS Robotic Smart Series is a multi-purpose robotic sample preparation and injection system that automates complex GC and LC workflows.

products.name: Automated Solid Phase Extraction
products.description: Automated solid phase extraction system for sample cleanup and concentration.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Automated SPE is a fully automated solid phase extraction system for sample cleanup and concentration prior to chromatographic analysis.

products.name: Auto Twister-SBSE
products.description: Automated stir bar sorptive extraction for extraction and concentration of analytes.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Auto Twister is an automated stir bar sorptive extraction (SBSE) system for efficient extraction and concentration of analytes from liquid samples.

products.name: ODP — Olfactory Detection Port
products.description: Olfactory detection port for human sensory evaluation coupled with GC analysis.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel ODP (Olfactory Detection Port) enables human sensory evaluation coupled directly with gas chromatographic analysis.

products.name: Automated Sample Prep Workstation
products.description: Integrated automated workstation for sample preparation including dilution, derivatization, and extraction.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Automated Sample Prep Workstation is an integrated robotic platform for automating complex sample preparation workflows including dilution, derivatization, extraction, and concentration.

products.name: Pyrolysis
products.description: Thermal decomposition system for analysis of non-volatile polymers and materials.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Pyrolysis System is a thermal decomposition unit for analysis of non-volatile polymers, materials, and complex organic matrices.

products.name: Thermal Desorption TD 3.5
products.description: High-performance thermal desorption system for analysis of volatile and semi-volatile compounds.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Thermal Desorption System TD 3.5 is a high-performance sample introduction system for analysis of volatile and semi-volatile organic compounds (VOCs and SVOCs).

products.name: Dynamic Headspace
products.description: Dynamic headspace sampling system for enhanced extraction of volatile compounds.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Dynamic Headspace system enhances volatile compound extraction beyond static headspace analysis by continuously purging the sample with inert gas.

products.name: Vacuum ITEX
products.description: Vacuum-assisted in-tube extraction for enhanced sensitivity in sample preparation.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Vacuum ITEX (In-Tube Extraction) is a vacuum-assisted sample preparation technique that enhances extraction sensitivity for volatile and semi-volatile compounds.

products.name: Auto Tube Spiking and Dry Purge
products.fullName: Gerstel Auto Tube Spiking and Dry Purge+
products.description: Automated internal standard spiking and dry purging for sample preparation.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Auto Tube Spiking and Dry Purge+ automates internal standard spiking and dry purging procedures for sample preparation.

products.name: mVAP — Multi Position Evaporative System
products.description: Multi-position evaporation system for sample concentration and solvent removal.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel mVAP is a multi-position evaporation system designed for sample concentration and solvent removal in preparation for chromatographic analysis.

products.name: Dynamic Focusing
products.description: Dynamic focusing trap for enhanced pre-concentration of volatile analytes.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Dynamic Focusing is a pre-concentration trap system that enhances sensitivity for volatile analytes by focusing them on a sorbent or cryogenically cooled trap.

products.name: CIS Inlet
products.description: Cooled injection system inlet for cryogenic focusing and PTV-type injection.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel CIS (Cooled Injection System) is a multi-mode inlet for cryogenic focusing and PTV-type injection of volatile and semi-volatile compounds.

products.name: ALEX — Automatic Liner Exchange
products.description: Automatic liner exchange system for elimination of carryover between samples.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel ALEX (Automatic Liner Exchange) eliminates carryover between samples by automatically swapping GC inlet liners between injections.

products.name: Auto QuickMix
products.description: Automated sample mixing system for homogenization before analysis.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Auto QuickMix is an automated sample mixing system that ensures thorough homogenization of sample vials before injection.

products.name: Auto Centrifuge
products.description: Automated centrifuge for sample separation as part of integrated sample preparation.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Auto Centrifuge is an automated centrifuge designed for sample separation as part of integrated, unattended sample preparation workflows.

products.name: Auto Sample Filtration
products.description: Automated sample filtration system for particulate removal before analysis.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Auto Sample Filtration system automates particulate removal from liquid samples before chromatographic injection.

products.name: Automated UltraSonic
products.description: Automated ultrasonic extraction system for enhanced sample preparation.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Automated UltraSonic is an automated ultrasonic extraction system that enhances sample preparation through controlled ultrasonic energy application.

products.name: Auto Barcode Reader
products.description: Automated barcode reader for sample tracking and identification in automated workflows.
products.fullDescription: The Gerstel Auto Barcode Reader provides automated sample tracking and identification in high-throughput laboratory workflows.

products.name: Peak Scientific Gas Generators
products.description: High-performance gas generators for laboratory GC, LC-MS, and other analytical instruments.
products.fullDescription: Peak Scientific Gas Generators provide high-purity nitrogen, hydrogen, and zero air on-demand for laboratory GC, LC-MS, and other analytical instruments.

products.name: VICI Valves and Special GC/LC Connections
products.fullName: VICI Valves and Special GC/LC Connections
products.description: Precision valves and connectors for GC and LC systems for sample switching and flow control.
products.fullDescription: VICI Valves and Special GC/LC Connections provide precision-engineered valves, fittings, and connectors for gas chromatography and liquid chromatography systems.

products.name: Bandelin Smart High Performance Ultrasonics
products.description: High-performance ultrasonic homogenizers and cleaners for laboratory sample preparation.
products.fullDescription: Bandelin Smart High Performance Ultrasonics delivers high-performance ultrasonic homogenizers and cleaners for laboratory sample preparation.

products.name: IKA Sample Prep Systems
products.description: Trouble-free sample preparation systems including mills, stirrers, and homogenizers by IKA.
products.fullDescription: IKA Sample Prep Systems provide trouble-free sample preparation solutions including mills, stirrers, and homogenizers from the renowned German manufacturer IKA.

products.name: DWK High Precision and Grade Glassware
products.fullName: DWK High Precision and Grade Glassware
products.description: Precision laboratory glassware for analytical and research applications.
products.fullDescription: DWK High Precision and Grade Glassware provides precision-manufactured laboratory glassware for analytical chemistry and research applications.

categories.name: Scientific Equipments
categories.description: Precision scientific instruments for mixing, heating, separation, and sample preparation.

products.name: RCT basic
products.description: Heating magnetic stirrer with ceramic hot plate for temperatures up to 310°C.
products.fullDescription: The IKA RCT basic is a versatile heating magnetic stirrer featuring a durable ceramic hot plate capable of reaching 310°C. With a stirring capacity of up to 20 liters and speed range of 50-1500 rpm, it handles a wide range of laboratory mixing and heating applications. The RCT basic offers excellent value with robust construction and reliable performance.

products.name: RET basic
products.description: Premium heating magnetic stirrer with integrated temperature control for precise applications.
products.fullDescription: The IKA RET basic is a premium heating magnetic stirrer with integrated temperature control capability, supporting external temperature sensors for precise medium temperature regulation. With stirring capacity up to 20 liters and speeds up to 1700 rpm, it delivers reliable performance for demanding laboratory applications requiring accurate temperature control.

products.name: C-MAG HS 7
products.description: Ceramic hotplate stirrer with extended temperature range up to 500°C.
products.fullDescription: The IKA C-MAG HS 7 is a powerful ceramic hotplate magnetic stirrer capable of reaching temperatures up to 500°C. With 10-liter stirring capacity and 1500 rpm speed, it provides robust heating and mixing for demanding applications. The ceramic plate offers excellent chemical resistance and easy cleaning.

products.name: EUROSTAR 200
products.description: Digital overhead stirrer for mixing viscous substances up to 200,000 mPa·s.
products.fullDescription: The IKA EUROSTAR 200 is a powerful digital overhead stirrer designed for mixing viscous substances up to 200,000 mPa·s. With adjustable speed from 6 to 2000 rpm and a maximum torque of 200 Ncm, it handles demanding mixing tasks in chemical, pharmaceutical, and food laboratories. The digital display provides precise speed and torque feedback.

products.name: KS 4000 i control
products.fullName: IKA KS 4000 i control Digital Overhead Stirrer
products.description: High-performance overhead stirrer with integrated temperature control.
products.fullDescription: The IKA KS 4000 i control is a high-performance digital overhead stirrer with integrated temperature control for precise viscosity-dependent mixing. With maximum torque of 400 Ncm and speed up to 2000 rpm, it handles the most demanding mixing applications. The integrated control system ensures reproducible results.

products.name: C-MAG hotplate HS 7
products.description: Ceramic hotplate without stirring function for pure heating applications.
products.fullDescription: The IKA C-MAG hotplate HS 7 is a ceramic hotplate designed for pure heating applications without stirring. Capable of reaching 500°C, it provides uniform heating for a variety of laboratory tasks. The ceramic plate offers excellent chemical resistance and easy maintenance.

products.name: polygine C-MAG 1
products.description: Multi-position magnetic stirrer for high-throughput parallel mixing.
products.fullDescription: The IKA polygine C-MAG 1 is a multi-position magnetic stirrer capable of simultaneous mixing of up to 4 positions. With independent speed control and ceramic hotplates, it enables efficient parallel sample preparation for research and quality control applications.

products.name: T 25 digital
products.description: High-performance disperser for homogenization, emulsification, and particle size reduction.
products.fullDescription: The IKA T 25 digital ULTRA-TURRAX is a high-performance disperser designed for efficient homogenization, emulsification, and particle size reduction of liquid samples. With speed up to 25,000 rpm and various dispersing elements, it delivers consistent results for sample preparation in research and quality control laboratories.

products.name: ULTRA-TURRAX UTT-s
products.description: Standalone disperser system for reproducible sample preparation.
products.fullDescription: The IKA ULTRA-TURRAX UTT-s 1000 Solo is a standalone disperser system providing consistent and reproducible sample homogenization. Designed for routine laboratory applications, it offers ease of use with reliable performance for sample preparation across various industries.

products.name: A 11 basic
products.description: Analytical mill for grinding of soft, medium-hard, and fibrous materials.
products.fullDescription: The IKA A 11 basic is an analytical mill designed for efficient grinding of soft, medium-hard, and fibrous materials. With a powerful motor and stainless steel cutting blades, it provides rapid size reduction for sample preparation in analytical laboratories.

products.name: M 20 universal
products.description: Universal mill for grinding of soft, hard, brittle, and fibrous samples.
products.fullDescription: The IKA M 20 universal mill is designed for grinding of soft, hard, brittle, and fibrous samples with interchangeable cutting and impact blades. It provides flexible sample preparation for a wide range of materials in research and quality control laboratories.

products.name: MS 3 basic
products.description: Compact shaker for mixing tasks in laboratory applications.
products.fullDescription: The IKA MS 3 basic is a compact shaker designed for mixing tasks in laboratory applications. With adjustable speed and various attachment options, it handles tubes, flasks, and microplates efficiently.

products.name: TS 100
products.description: Temperature-controlled shaker for simultaneous heating and mixing.
products.fullDescription: The IKA TS 100 Thermoshaker combines heating and shaking in one unit for applications requiring temperature-controlled mixing. Ideal for enzyme reactions, incubation, and sample preparation.

products.name: Calyos NS1
products.fullName: IKA Calyos NS1 Dry Block Heater
products.description: Dry block heater for precise temperature control of samples in tubes.
products.fullDescription: The IKA Calyos NS1 Dry Block Heater provides precise temperature control for samples in tubes and vials. With interchangeable blocks and digital temperature control, it ensures uniform heating for laboratory applications.

products.name: Bath thermostat
products.description: Heating bath for temperature control of samples in water or oil.
products.fullDescription: The IKA Heating Bath provides precise temperature control for samples immersed in water or oil. With digital temperature control and various bath sizes, it serves as a reliable heat source for laboratory applications.

products.name: ETS-D5
products.description: External temperature controller for precise bath and reactor temperature regulation.
products.fullDescription: The IKA ETS-D5 is an external temperature controller for precise regulation of bath and reactor temperatures. With Pt100 sensor input and PID control, it delivers accurate temperature management for demanding applications.

products.name: ITC-1
products.description: Incubator for temperature-controlled sample storage and cultivation.
products.fullDescription: The IKA ITC-1 Incubator provides temperature-controlled environment for sample storage, cultivation, and incubation. With precise temperature control and uniform heat distribution, it serves biological and chemical laboratory applications.

products.name: T 10 basic
products.description: Single-use disperser element for sterile sample homogenization.
products.fullDescription: The IKA T 10 basic ULTRA-TURRAX with single-use dispersing element provides sterile homogenization of samples without cross-contamination. Ideal for clinical, pharmaceutical, and biological applications requiring single-use components.

products.name: viscostar
products.description: Rotational viscometer for viscosity measurement of liquids and semi-solids.
products.fullDescription: The IKA viscostar is a rotational viscometer designed for accurate viscosity measurement of liquids, pastes, and semi-solids. With multiple spindle options and adjustable speed, it covers a wide viscosity range for laboratory and QC applications.

products.name: C2000
products.description: Oxygen bomb calorimeter for heat of combustion measurement.
products.fullDescription: The IKA C2000 is an oxygen bomb calorimeter for precise measurement of heat of combustion in solid and liquid samples. Featuring automatic ignition and adiabatic design, it delivers accurate calorific value determination for fuels, food, and materials.

products.name: PURELAB Flex
products.fullName: ELGA PURELAB Flex Water Purification System
products.description: Point-of-use water purification system delivering Type 1 ultrapure water on demand.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA PURELAB Flex is a compact point-of-use water purification system that delivers Type 1 ultrapure water on demand. Featuring integrated monitoring and a compact design, it provides consistent high-purity water for critical laboratory applications including HPLC, ICP-MS, and molecular biology.

products.name: PURELAB Quest
products.fullName: ELGA PURELAB Quest Water Purification System
products.description: Centralized water purification system providing Type 1 ultrapure water for multiple users.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA PURELAB Quest is a centralized water purification system designed to deliver consistent Type 1 ultrapure water to multiple users simultaneously. Ideal for laboratories requiring a continuous supply of high-purity water for critical analytical and research applications.

products.name: PURELAB Chorus
products.fullName: ELGA PURELAB Chorus Water Purification System
products.description: Modular water purification system delivering pure and ultrapure water from potable source.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA PURELAB Chorus is a modular water purification system that produces both pure (Type 2) and ultrapure (Type 1) water directly from potable water. With multiple configurations available, it adapts to varying laboratory water quality requirements and flow demands.

products.name: CENTRA® R200
products.fullName: ELGA CENTRA® R200 Centralized Water System
products.description: Centralized water purification system providing RO, deionization, and UV treatment for multiple lab outlets.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA CENTRA® R200 is a centralized water purification system designed to supply multiple laboratory outlets with high-purity water. Combining reverse osmosis, continuous deionization, and UV treatment, it delivers Type I, II, and III water from a single unit.

products.name: MEDICA® 160
products.description: Water purification system designed for clinical laboratory and medical applications.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA MEDICA® 160 is a water purification system specifically designed for clinical laboratories and medical applications. Producing Type II water suitable for clinical analyzers, dialysis, and sterilization, it meets medical-grade water standards.

products.name: BIOPURE® Quartz
products.fullName: ELGA BIOPURE® Quartz Ultrapure Water Polishing System
products.description: Point-of-use polishing system for producing Type I ultrapure water with low TOC and endotoxins.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA BIOPURE® Quartz is a point-of-use ultrapure water polishing system that removes trace contaminants to produce Type I water. With integrated UV oxidation, ion exchange, and ultrafiltration, it delivers water with ultra-low TOC, endotoxin, and particulate levels.

products.name: PURELAB® Pro
products.description: Centralized water purification system delivering multiple water grades to lab outlets.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA PURELAB® Pro is a centralized water purification system that distributes multiple grades of purified water (Type I, II, and III) from a single location to multiple lab points of use. Reduces infrastructure costs and simplifies maintenance.

products.name: Hydrogen Generator
products.description: On-demand hydrogen gas generation for carrier and fuel gas applications.
products.fullDescription: The ELGA Hydrogen Gas Generator produces high-purity hydrogen on demand from deionized water through electrolysis. Eliminating the need for compressed gas cylinders, it provides a safe, continuous supply for GC carrier gas, FID fuel gas, and other laboratory uses.

products.name: HiMACTM Micro
products.description: Compact benchtop microcentrifuge for molecular biology and clinical applications.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HiMACTM Micro is a compact benchtop microcentrifuge designed for molecular biology, clinical, and research applications. With a maximum speed of 14,000 rpm and various rotor options, it provides efficient separation of small-volume samples in microtubes and PCR tubes.

products.name: HiMACTM Refrigerated
products.description: Refrigerated benchtop centrifuge for temperature-sensitive sample separation.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HiMACTM Refrigerated Centrifuge features a built-in cooling system for temperature-sensitive sample separation. With a temperature range of -20°C to +40°C and multiple rotor options, it handles a wide range of centrifugation applications in research and clinical laboratories.

products.name: LF-100
products.description: Low speed centrifuge for routine sample separation in clinical and research labs.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil LF-100 Low Speed Centrifuge is designed for routine sample separation in clinical, research, and industrial laboratories. With programmable speed and time, it provides reliable separation of blood, urine, and other biological samples.

products.name: UH-6500
products.description: Ultracentrifuge for high-speed separation of subcellular components and macromolecules.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil UH-6500 Ultracentrifuge operates at ultra-high speeds for separation of subcellular organelles, viruses, and macromolecules. With vacuum system and temperature control, it handles demanding molecular biology and biochemistry applications.

products.name: HF-16000
products.description: High speed centrifuge for separation of cell organelles and protein precipitates.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HF-16000 High Speed Centrifuge provides high RCF for separation of cell organelles, protein precipitates, and subcellular fractions. With multiple rotor options and refrigeration capability, it serves research and pharmaceutical laboratories.

products.name: HDC-12000
products.description: Versatile multi-purpose centrifuge for a wide range of laboratory applications.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HDC-12000 Multi-Purpose Centrifuge offers versatility for clinical, research, and industrial applications. Compatible with numerous rotor types, it handles microcentrifuge tubes, blood bags, and large-volume containers.

products.name: HC-6000
products.description: Large capacity centrifuge for high-volume sample processing in industrial labs.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HC-6000 Large Capacity Centrifuge handles high-volume sample processing for industrial and clinical applications. With swing-out rotors and large-capacity buckets, it processes blood bags, urine samples, and industrial suspensions efficiently.

products.name: HFC-3000
products.description: Clinical centrifuge for blood and body fluid separation in hospitals and clinics.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HFC-3000 Clinical Centrifuge is designed for routine blood and body fluid separation in hospitals, clinics, and point-of-care settings. With pre-programmed clinical protocols, it ensures consistent and compliant sample preparation.

products.name: HIC-8000
products.description: Industrial centrifuge for production-scale separation in manufacturing.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HIC-8000 Industrial Centrifuge handles production-scale separation for pharmaceutical, chemical, and food manufacturing. With stainless steel construction and GMP-compliant design, it meets industrial quality standards.

products.name: HSC-500
products.description: Sample concentrator for evaporation and concentration of biological samples.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HSC-500 Sample Concentrator provides gentle evaporation and concentration of biological samples including nucleic acids, proteins, and metabolites. With nitrogen blow-down technology, it concentrates samples without thermal degradation.

products.name: HVP-100
products.description: Centrifugal vacuum concentrator for rapid sample drying without heat damage.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HVP-100 Centrifugal Vacuum Concentrator combines centrifugal force with vacuum evaporation for rapid, heat-sensitive sample drying. Ideal for concentrating nucleic acids, proteins, and other biomolecules without thermal degradation.

products.name: HFD-1000
products.description: Freeze dryer for lyophilization of biological and pharmaceutical samples.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HFD-1000 Freeze Dryer provides efficient lyophilization for preservation of biological samples, pharmaceuticals, and food products. With programmable drying cycles and ice condenser, it maintains sample integrity during dehydration.

products.name: HGP-200
products.description: Gas purging evaporator for rapid solvent evaporation from multiple samples.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HGP-200 Gas Purging Evaporator uses inert gas purging to rapidly evaporate solvents from multiple samples simultaneously. With adjustable gas flow and temperature control, it accelerates sample preparation in analytical laboratories.

products.name: HIC-80
products.description: CO₂ incubator for cell culture and tissue engineering applications.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HIC-80 CO₂ Incubator provides precise temperature, humidity, and CO₂ control for cell culture, tissue engineering, and microbiological applications. With HEPA filtration and contamination control, it maintains sterile culture conditions.

products.name: HUF-86
products.description: Ultra-low temperature freezer for long-term storage of biological samples.
products.fullDescription: The Hanil HUF-86 Ultra-Low Freezer maintains temperatures down to -86°C for long-term storage of biological samples, cell lines, sera, and reagents. With dual compressor system and alarm, it ensures reliable sample preservation.

categories.name: Testing Apparatus
categories.description: Testing and quality control equipment for laboratory and field applications.

products.name: DR3900
products.description: Benchtop spectrophotometer with touchscreen for drinking water and wastewater analysis.
products.fullDescription: The HACH DR3900 is a high-end benchtop spectrophotometer designed for drinking water and wastewater analysis. Featuring a 7-inch touchscreen display and over 340 pre-programmed methods, it delivers accurate and reliable results for a wide range of water quality parameters. Built-in data management with USB and Ethernet connectivity for seamless data transfer.

products.name: DR6000
products.description: UV-Vis spectrophotometer for advanced water quality analysis with 3D scanning capability.
products.fullDescription: The HACH DR6000 UV-Vis spectrophotometer is designed for advanced water quality analysis with full UV-Vis scanning capability (190-1100 nm). It features 3D scanning for advanced method development and comes with over 340 pre-programmed methods. Ideal for laboratories requiring high-precision UV-Vis measurements.

products.name: DR1900
products.description: Versatile benchtop spectrophotometer for routine water quality testing.
products.fullDescription: The HACH DR1900 is a versatile benchtop spectrophotometer designed for routine water quality testing. With over 200 pre-programmed methods and a user-friendly interface, it provides reliable results for drinking water, wastewater, and environmental applications. Compact design fits any laboratory workspace.

products.name: HQ40d
products.description: Advanced multi-parameter digital meter for pH, conductivity, DO, and turbidity measurements.
products.fullDescription: The HACH HQ40d is an advanced multi-parameter digital meter that accepts up to two IntelliCAL or LDO probes simultaneously. With automatic method selection, digital connectivity, and rugged design, it delivers accurate and reliable measurements for pH, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, and turbidity in the field and laboratory.

products.name: sensION+ PH
products.fullName: HACH sensION+ PH Benchtop pH Meter
products.description: Benchtop pH meter with advanced electrode diagnostics for laboratory precision.
products.fullDescription: The HACH sensION+ PH is a high-performance benchtop pH meter designed for laboratory use. Featuring advanced electrode diagnostics, auto-calibration, and GLP data management, it delivers precise pH measurements with full traceability. Ideal for QC labs and research applications.

products.name: 2100Q
products.description: EPA-compliant benchtop turbidimeter for drinking water and wastewater monitoring.
products.fullDescription: The HACH 2100Q turbidimeter is an EPA-compliant instrument designed for accurate turbidity measurements in drinking water and wastewater applications. Featuring ratio measurement technology and adaptive algorithms, it delivers reliable results from 0-4000 NTU with excellent low-end sensitivity.

products.name: LDO
products.description: Luminescent DO probe with no membrane maintenance for accurate oxygen measurement.
products.fullDescription: The HACH LDO luminescent dissolved oxygen probe uses optical technology to deliver accurate DO measurements without the maintenance required by membrane-based sensors. With no electrolyte to refill and no membrane to replace, it provides reliable, long-term monitoring for wastewater treatment and environmental applications.

products.name: DR900
products.description: Portable colorimeter for field water testing of chlorine, pH, and other parameters.
products.fullDescription: The HACH DR900 Portable Colorimeter is designed for field water quality testing with pre-programmed methods for chlorine, pH, nitrate, and other parameters. Compact and rugged, it delivers accurate results in harsh field conditions.

products.name: Titralab
products.description: Automatic titration system for alkalinity, hardness, and chloride measurement.
products.fullDescription: The HACH Titralab Titrator provides fully automated potentiometric titration for alkalinity, hardness, chloride, and other water quality parameters. With multiple method storage and auto-sampler compatibility, it increases laboratory throughput.

products.name: sensION+ MM374
products.description: Multi-parameter benchtop meter for pH, conductivity, DO, and turbidity.
products.fullDescription: The HACH sensION+ MM374 is a multi-parameter benchtop meter supporting pH, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, and turbidity measurements. With dual channels and GLP compliance, it serves as a versatile laboratory workhorse.

products.name: IntelliCAL PHC101
products.description: Digital pH probe with IntelliCAL technology for automatic calibration recognition.
products.fullDescription: The HACH IntelliCAL PHC101 is a digital pH probe featuring IntelliCAL technology for automatic method and calibration recognition. With gel electrolyte and built-in temperature sensor, it delivers reliable pH measurements in field and lab.

products.name: TNTplus Vial Tests
products.description: Pre-measured reagent vials for rapid colorimetric water quality testing.
products.fullDescription: HACH TNTplus Vial Chemistry Tests are pre-measured, pre-filled reagent vials for rapid colorimetric analysis of water quality parameters. Simply add sample, incubate, and read in a compatible HACH spectrophotometer for fast, accurate results.

products.name: Pocket Pro
products.description: Handheld colorimeter for quick field measurement of chlorine and pH.
products.fullDescription: The HACH Pocket Pro is a compact handheld colorimeter for quick field measurement of free/total chlorine, pH, and bromine. Waterproof and rugged, it fits in a pocket for on-the-go water quality testing.

products.name: Calibration Standards
products.description: NIST-traceable calibration standards for pH, conductivity, and turbidity instruments.
products.fullDescription: HACH Calibration Standard Solutions are NIST-traceable reference solutions for accurate calibration of pH, conductivity, turbidity, and dissolved oxygen instruments. Available in various concentrations and volumes.

products.name: DR6000 Online
products.description: Online UV-Vis analyzer for continuous monitoring of water quality parameters.
products.fullDescription: The HACH DR6000 Online Analyzer provides continuous UV-Vis absorption measurement for real-time monitoring of organic compounds, nitrate, and turbidity in water and wastewater streams.

products.name: TOC Analyzer
products.description: TOC analyzer for measurement of total organic carbon in ultrapure and process water.
products.fullDescription: The HACH Total Organic Carbon (TOC) Analyzer measures organic carbon contamination in ultrapure water, pharmaceutical water, and wastewater. Using UV/persulfate oxidation, it provides accurate TOC measurement for regulatory compliance.

products.name: Astream Analyzer
products.description: Automated wet chemistry analyzer for high-throughput nutrient and parameter testing.
products.fullDescription: The HACH Astream Automated Analyzer performs simultaneous measurement of multiple water quality parameters including ammonia, nitrate, phosphate, and silica. With continuous flow analysis, it handles high-throughput laboratory testing.

products.name: SSC Controller
products.description: Smart controller for online process monitoring and data acquisition.
products.fullDescription: The HACH Smart Sensor Controller (SSC) connects multiple online sensors and provides centralized process monitoring, data logging, and control outputs. With web-based interface, it simplifies water treatment plant automation.

products.name: AS950 Sampler
products.description: Portable peristaltic sampler for composite and discrete wastewater sampling.
products.fullDescription: The HACH AS950 Peristaltic Sampler collects composite and discrete wastewater samples for laboratory analysis. Portable and weather-resistant, it supports flow-paced and time-paced sampling protocols.

products.name: Test Strips
products.description: Quick-test strips for visual and instrument-based water quality screening.
products.fullDescription: HACH Water Test Strips provide quick, on-site screening for pH, chlorine, hardness, iron, and other water quality parameters. Color-changing pads allow visual reading or instrument verification.

products.name: Culture Media
products.description: Ready-to-use culture media for coliform and heterotrophic plate count testing.
products.fullDescription: HACH Culture Media provides ready-to-use agar plates and broth for coliform, E. coli, and heterotrophic plate count (HPC) testing in drinking water and wastewater applications.

products.name: Lab Glassware
products.description: Laboratory glassware including beakers, flasks, and sample containers for water testing.
products.fullDescription: HACH Laboratory Glassware includes high-quality borosilicate beakers, Erlenmeyer flasks, graduated cylinders, and sample containers designed for water quality testing procedures.

products.name: Sample Prep Tools
products.description: Sample preparation tools including filtration, digestion, and mixing equipment.
products.fullDescription: HACH Sample Preparation Tools includes filtration apparatus, digestion blocks, magnetic stirrers, and mixing equipment for preparing water samples before analysis.

products.name: Field Testing & Analysis
products.description: Complete field testing systems for on-site water quality analysis.
products.fullDescription: HACH Field Testing & Analysis Systems provide complete portable solutions for on-site water quality testing. Including spectrophotometers, pH meters, and test kits in rugged field cases for environmental monitoring and wastewater compliance.

products.name: Claros Water Intelligence System
products.description: Cloud-based water intelligence platform for real-time monitoring and predictive analytics.
products.fullDescription: The HACH Claros™ Water Intelligence System is a cloud-based platform that connects HACH instruments, provides real-time data visualization, predictive maintenance alerts, and compliance reporting. Enables data-driven decision making for water quality operations.

products.name: Instrument Management
products.description: Instrument management services including calibration, maintenance, and compliance support.
products.fullDescription: HACH Instrument Management Services provide comprehensive calibration, preventive maintenance, and compliance support for water quality instruments. Ensures instruments are always accurate and compliant with regulatory requirements.

products.name: Electrodes & Sensors
products.description: Electrochemical electrodes and sensors for pH, ORP, conductivity, and dissolved oxygen measurement.
products.fullDescription: HACH Electrochemical Electrodes & Sensors provide accurate measurement of pH, ORP, conductivity, and dissolved oxygen. Available in combinations, gel-filled, and refillable types for laboratory and process applications.

categories.name: Laboratory Furnitures
categories.description: Laboratory furniture, benches, and workspace solutions.

categories.name: Turnkey
categories.description: Complete integrated solutions and systems ready for deployment.

products.name: Lab Molecular Distillation
products.fullName: TOPTION Lab Scale Molecular Distillation Equipment
products.description: Laboratory-scale molecular distillation system for purification and separation of heat-sensitive materials.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Lab Scale Molecular Distillation Equipment is designed for purification and separation of heat-sensitive, high-boiling-point materials. With short-path evaporation technology, it provides efficient separation with minimal thermal degradation. Ideal for pharmaceutical, chemical, and food processing applications.

products.name: Short Path Distillation
products.description: Short-path distillation system for high-purity separation of complex mixtures.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Short Path Distillation System utilizes short-path evaporation for efficient separation of complex mixtures with high purity requirements. Featuring glass or stainless steel construction, it delivers precise temperature control and vacuum operation for demanding distillation applications.

products.name: Jacketed Glass Reactor
products.description: Jacketed glass reactor with dual-wall design for precise temperature control during reactions.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Jacketed Double Glass Reactor features a dual-wall glass design allowing circulation of heating or cooling fluids for precise temperature control during chemical reactions. Available in 1L-100L sizes with interchangeable glassware and modular accessories.

products.name: Supercritical CO2 Extraction
products.fullName: TOPTION Supercritical Fluid Extraction SFE System
products.description: Supercritical CO2 extraction system for solvent-free extraction of natural compounds.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Supercritical Fluid Extraction (SFE) System uses supercritical CO2 as the extraction solvent for efficient, solvent-free extraction of natural compounds. Featuring precise temperature and pressure control, it delivers high-purity extracts for pharmaceutical, food, and botanical applications.

products.name: Freeze Dryer
products.description: Lyophilization system for preservation of sensitive biological and food materials.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Food Freeze-Drying Equipment (Lyophilizer) is designed for preservation of sensitive biological, pharmaceutical, and food materials through sublimation. With precise temperature control and vacuum operation, it maintains product integrity while removing water content.

products.name: Wiped Film Evaporator
products.description: Wiped film evaporator for continuous distillation of heat-sensitive, viscous materials.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Wiped Film Distillation System uses a rotating wiper to create a thin film of material on a heated wall for continuous evaporation and separation. Ideal for heat-sensitive, high-viscosity materials in pharmaceutical and chemical processing.

products.name: Rotary Evaporator
products.description: Rotary evaporator for efficient solvent removal and concentration under vacuum.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Rotary Evaporator (Rotovap) efficiently removes solvents from samples through evaporation under reduced pressure. With motorized lift, digital temperature and speed control, it serves laboratory distillation and concentration tasks.

products.name: Stainless Steel Reactor
products.description: High-pressure stainless steel reactor for chemical synthesis and material testing.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Stainless Steel Reactor provides high-pressure reaction environment for chemical synthesis, hydrothermal reactions, and material testing. With temperature and pressure control, it handles demanding reaction conditions.

products.name: Centrifuge Extractor
products.description: Centrifugal extractor for liquid-liquid extraction and phase separation.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Centrifugal Extraction System uses centrifugal force for efficient liquid-liquid extraction and phase separation. Ideal for pharmaceutical, food, and chemical applications requiring rapid and clean separation of immiscible liquids.

products.name: Essential Oil Extractor
products.description: Steam distillation unit for extraction of essential oils from plant materials.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Essential Oil Distillation Unit uses steam distillation to extract essential oils from plant materials including flowers, leaves, bark, and roots. Available in lab and pilot scale for R&D and small-batch production.

products.name: Temperature Control Unit
products.description: Heating and cooling circulator for precise temperature control of reactors and processes.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Temperature Control Unit provides heating and cooling circulation for precise temperature control of reactors, evaporators, and process equipment. With digital PID control and safety features, it ensures stable operation.

products.name: Ice Bath Chiller
products.description: Ice bath system for rapid cooling of samples and reactions.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Ice Bath Chiller System provides rapid, controlled cooling for samples, reactions, and extractions. Maintaining temperatures from 0°C to -20°C, it replaces traditional ice baths with consistent, automated cooling.

products.name: Nutsche Filter
products.description: Nutsche filter for vacuum filtration and isolation of solid-liquid mixtures.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Nutsche Filtration System combines filtration and drying in one vessel for efficient solid-liquid separation. With vacuum capability and temperature control, it processes pharmaceutical and chemical intermediates.

products.name: Spray Dryer
products.description: Laboratory spray dryer for producing powder from liquid solutions and emulsions.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Laboratory Spray Dryer converts liquid solutions, emulsions, and suspensions into dry powder through atomization and hot air drying. With cyclone separator and collection vessel, it produces uniform particles for food, pharma, and materials applications.

products.name: Vacuum Oven
products.description: Vacuum drying oven for low-temperature drying of heat-sensitive materials.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Vacuum Drying Oven provides low-temperature drying under vacuum for heat-sensitive, oxidizable, and complex compounds. With precise temperature control and vacuum gauge, it ensures gentle, efficient dehydration.

products.name: Rising Film Evaporator
products.description: Rising film evaporator for concentration of heat-sensitive liquid solutions.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Rising Film Evaporator allows liquid to rise as a thin film along heated tube walls for rapid evaporation. Ideal for concentrating heat-sensitive solutions in food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries.

products.name: Falling Film Evaporator
products.description: Falling film evaporator for continuous evaporation of heat-sensitive liquids.
products.fullDescription: The TOPTION Falling Film Evaporator distributes liquid as a thin film on the inside of heated tubes, allowing rapid, continuous evaporation. Ideal for concentrating heat-sensitive products with short residence time.

products.name: Standard Glove Box
products.description: Standard inert atmosphere glovebox for air-sensitive research and material handling.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX Standard Glovebox provides an inert atmosphere environment with less than 1 ppm H2O and O2 for air-sensitive research applications. Featuring stainless steel construction, antechamber, and integrated purification system, it is ideal for lithium battery research, materials science, and pharmaceutical applications.

products.name: Vacuum Glove Box
products.description: High-vacuum glovebox for ultra-pure inert atmosphere applications.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX Vacuum Glove Box provides ultra-pure inert atmosphere with deep vacuum capability for demanding applications requiring extremely low oxygen and moisture levels. Ideal for semiconductor research, advanced materials, and OLED development.

products.name: GP20 Gas Purifier
products.description: Gas purification system for removing O2 and H2O from inert gas supplies.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX GP20 Gas Purification System removes oxygen and moisture from inert gas supplies (N2, Ar, He) to deliver ultra-pure gas for glovebox and process applications. Featuring automatic regeneration and long-life purification columns.

products.name: Cleanroom Glovebox
products.description: Glovebox with integrated HEPA filtration for cleanroom-compatible inert atmosphere work.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX Cleanroom Glovebox combines high-purity inert atmosphere control with integrated HEPA filtration for cleanroom-compatible operations. Designed for semiconductor and pharmaceutical manufacturing environments requiring ISO Class 5 or better air quality.

products.name: Acrylic Glovebox
products.description: Transparent acrylic glovebox for demonstration and low-demand inert atmosphere work.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX Acrylic Glovebox provides a transparent, cost-effective enclosure for demonstration, display, and low-demand inert atmosphere work. Its clear acrylic walls allow full visibility, making it ideal for educational and display purposes.

products.name: Solvent Purifier
products.description: Inline solvent purification column for removing water, oxygen, and protic impurities from organic solvents.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX Solvent Purification System uses activated alumina, molecular sieves, and metal catalyst columns to remove water, oxygen, and protic impurities from common organic solvents inline. Compatible with standard solvent dispensing systems.

products.name: Vacuum Coating System
products.description: Vacuum thermal evaporation system for thin film deposition of metals and organics.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX Vacuum Thermal Evaporation Coater deposits thin films of metals, organics, and other materials under high vacuum by resistive heating. Used for research-scale thin film production in electronics, optics, and materials science.

products.name: Laboratory Isolator
products.description: Positive/negative pressure isolator for containment of hazardous materials and potent compounds.
products.fullDescription: The ETELUX Containment Isolator provides operator and product protection through controlled positive or negative pressure environments. HEPA-filtered exhaust and supply air ensure containment of hazardous powders, potent APIs, and cytotoxic materials.
